title: predict
summary: Predict responses from a fitted model.

gpu_support.notes: GPU predictor inputs are gathered to host for model prediction.

description: `predict(mdl,Xnew)` evaluates a `LinearModel` returned by `fitlm` on new matrix or table predictor data.
behaviors: `Xnew` can be a numeric matrix with the same predictor column count used during fitting.
For table input, predictor variables are selected by the model's `PredictorNames` property.
`[ypred,yci] = predict(...)` returns pointwise confidence intervals for curve predictions by default.

Name-value options `Alpha`, `Prediction`, and `Simultaneous` are accepted. `Prediction` can be `curve` or `observation`; `Simultaneous` must be false because simultaneous intervals are not supported yet.

examples.output: yci is a two-column matrix with lower and upper bounds.

faqs.question: Which model classes are supported?
faqs.answer: Currently `predict` supports `LinearModel` objects returned by RunMat's `fitlm`.
